answer_1.quote: We further validate the effectiveness of applying the IntentionFrame data generated by the WeRG method to downstream conversational applications, specifically enhancing response generation in target-driven scenarios.
answer_1.outputs: IntentionFrame annotations and generated response texts

answer_2.quote: The automatic metrics include: (1) Content-based metrics (F1 and BLEU-1/2)... (2) Similarity-based metrics (BERTScore and BARTScore)... (3) LLM-as-a-Judge metric (Judge), where a strong LLM is employed to assess the alignment of the generated outputs with the ground-truth.

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-a-Judge metric (Judge), where a strong LLM is employed to assess the alignment of the generated outputs with the ground-truth IntentionFrames.

answer_4.quote: To complement automatic evaluation, we further conduct human evaluations on the generated IntentionFrame examples with three student annotators... The annotators were asked to rate the performance of various methods. We suggest several commonly used methodologies: Informativeness (Info.), Understanding (Und.), Conciseness (Con.).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated IntentionFrame on Informativeness, Understanding, and Conciseness.
